name: Rodney
text: Chris took the time to ask the right questions before the session and tailored the massage to exactly what I needed. It made a real difference and the treatment felt personalised rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. The location is peaceful, with natural birdsong creating a relaxing atmosphere from the moment you arrive. Combined with Chris’s knowledge and professionalism, it was an excellent experience. I left feeling refreshed and would happily recommend Chris to anyone looking for a quality massage. I will be back next time I’m in town.

name: My Herd
text: After eight nights sleeping in an uncomfortable bed while exploring the Whitsundays, I was left with an extremely sore neck and shoulders. I was fortunate to find Chris, who offers an in-house/mobile massage service. Chris came to the marina, set up on the back of our boat, and gave me an incredible two-hour massage. His professionalism, skill, and ability to target the areas causing me discomfort were exceptional. By the end of the session, I felt like a completely different person—refreshed, revitalised, and free of the tension I'd been carrying. The massage was so outstanding that we booked Chris to come to our hotel on each of the remaining two days of our holiday for additional treatments. Every session was consistently excellent. Without question, this was the best massage I've had in years. Chris has a genuine healing touch, and his treatments were both therapeutic and deeply relaxing. I couldn't recommend him more highly to anyone visiting the Whitsundays or looking for an exceptional mobile massage experience.

name: Jon Webb
text: A great massage, am booking again!

name: Debbie Glen
text: Omg Chris fixed my vertigo. He is amazing highly recommended

name: Tahlia Manuel
text: Chris was fantastic! He was able to fit me in promptly and at a convenient time for me. The massage itself was great, I was in the comfort of my own home and he was able to release a lot of tension from my sore back. Thank you again Chris!

name: Ann Rene Darger
text: Chris booked me in last minute same day. My massage was wonderful. He was kind and knows what he’s doing. My body felt incredible after. Will book again!

name: Jude And Peter Boon
text: Chris is very experienced in his field. Gentle but firm remedial massage.

name: Belinda Lee
text: Feeling so much better and would recommend you to anyone who needs a nice massage. Thankyou so much

name: Shayuri Deepak
text: My partner suprised me with a really relaxing and peaceful massage for my birthday. It is a mobile service and I had the pleasure of being massaged on my hotel room balcony with a beautiful view. Chris was professional and adjusted the pressure perfectly to suit my needs. I felt refreshed, calm, and much more comfortable overall. I would definitely do this again and recommend you try it!

name: Jacinta Hobbs
text: Had an in room massage at our hotel while in Airlie Beach with Chris, he listened to main problem areas to focus on and managed to help loosen up my shoulders which made the rest of our holiday alot easier to navigate. Would recommend his services to people looking for a great massage! Thanks again 😀

name: Debbie B
text: I had the most thorough massage by Chris this morning. Just the right firmness and a great chat to boot! Much appreciated!

name: Chris Thompson
text: Chris did a fantastic job for myself and my partner at the marina shores hotel. Absolutely amazing. Highly recommend this guy. Even got to us the same day as i called. Plus an all round great bloke. 10/10.

name: Marivic Geddes
text: Kudos to Club Wyndham Airlie Beach for partnering with Chris of In house Massage. It was done at the comfort of our room, he’s very professional, passionate and accomodating and and easy to talk to. He’s hands is like magic. As he targets all the body aches that we told him we need massaging. Will definitely recommend In House, will not disappoint for the price for two. we’ve been dying for this massage after our long 20hrs drive from Huntley Valley NSW to here at Airlie beach. Can’t wait to do another after we head home.

name: Makayla Smith
text: Came out last minute and worked magic

name: Ebonie Button
text: Chris was amazing!! Me and my partner had a full body massage done at Mirage Whitsundays and omg it was the best ever! So relaxing and feeling so great after. Chris works absolute magic & i would 100% recommend him to anyone & everyone.

name: Adrianna Klejnotowska
text: Thank you so much for a lovely relaxing massage at my hens!

name: Ashanti Pizzolato
text: Had a wonderful massage with Chris, who came directly to our Airbnb. The whole process was seamless from start to finish, and I felt completely relaxed afterwards. Highly recommend!

name: Sharon Simon
text: Contacted Chris very last minute because our boat day got cancelled and were trying to make our friends hens special - Chris answered right away, even though it was late and moved things around to fit us in the next morning. He came to our accommodation and honestly made the start of our day so so lovely and relaxing, felt like we were on a resort! His massage was so so good, me and the other 5 girls felt so relaxed and he got all our knots out. He was also just the loveliest person. highly highly recommended!

name: Narelle Russell
text: Had an amazing pain relieving massage with Chris. Very professional and caring. Chris uses effective methods to release tension from stressed muscles. Excellent will be squeezing in another appointment before we head home Great job

name: Megan Wicks
text: Chris came to our hotel room to give massages for 4 people, this was a last minute request and he accomated at all our needs perfectly. I had a sore back so had to be treated a little differently to the others and it was still perfect. Would highly recommend!!!

name: Angela McPhee
text: What a magical man. That massage was amazing. 10/10 recommend

name: Tarryn Puntigam
text: Chris came to our hotel last minute and was able to fit our whole group in for massages, which we really appreciated. He was friendly, professional and made everyone feel comfortable straight away. For me personally, I had a number of really sore spots and Chris immediately knew what they needed. He worked on them properly and managed to completely get rid of the pain. You can tell he really knows what he’s doing. Such a great service, especially when you don’t want to leave your accommodation. Would definitely book Chris again and highly recommend him!

name: Chanel Mason
text: Chris came to our hotel room to deliver 2x sports massages to me and my partner. This is so convenient as we are travelling and trying to fit as much in as possible. I would definitely recommend and not just because of how easy the booking was. The treatment was so good. I’m feeling ready to go in the morning and know, I’ll sleep very well tonight.

name: Perry Alexis
text: For sure the best Sports/Full body massage i have ever had! Chris was so attentive to each and every muscle and very professional. If you want a REAL sports massage that actually works then this is the place you need to book! 💯%

name: Antony Strong
text: I arrived in Airlie Beach to join a leg of the Clipper Round the World Yacht Race, sailing from Airlie Beach to Subic Bay in the Philippines and then on to Qingdao China. I had some lower back pain and was worried about how it would affect me on the race. I found Chris who came to my hotel twice in three days. The type of massage was spot on for the problem and I am pleased to report I made it to China with no back pain throughout the voyage, despite all of the stresses and strains that the trip put on my body. Very highly recommended. Thank you Chris.

name: Wendy Dwyer-Kimber
text: I was not feeling well. Thanks to the careful massage method of Chris I was close to cured of my stiffness, immobility and imbalance. Highly recommend to the start of relaxing holiday.

name: Kellie Lloyd
text: I found a flyer for Chris in the hotel lobby, and decided as it was rainy, I didn’t want to go out, so why not have the massage come to me. I booked online, it was so easy, an he was here an hour later. I was surprised how intuitive Chris was as a masseur. Besides my request from our chat beforehand, during the massage he could tell where I needed the focus, and worked away my knots and tension and I didn’t have to leave the hotel room. Might even get another massage before I head home. 100% recommend.

name: Catherine Hardingham
text: Chris came to the rescue after bad weather cancelled our planned boat trip. He happily came to our airbnb and massaged our group of 6. It was an excellent massage with nice deep pressure. We would highly recommend Chris, and it made our hens trip all the more special and relaxing!

name: Linda Reid
text: I highly recommend Chris for his professional and attentive approach. I went to Chris with lower back pain on holiday. Chris is very knowledgeable and took the time to assess my posture before starting. I did not expect a massage to fix my pain, I was able to travel 5 hours in a car the next day without pain. Thank you Chris, I live some distance away from Airlie Beach but will do my best to recommend you to all in need of such a professional therapist. Many Thanks Linda Reid

name: Shellee Sullivan
text: Loved the massage and love how Chris comes to you feel way better

name: Vesna
text: Chris is very good at his job, he consults clients about potential issues where he can help through massage with his skilled hands. His massage technique is very good, and he recognizes the areas of the body that need longer treatment. I am very impressed with his dedicated approach and would recommend him to others so they can fully enjoy his skills.

name: Kylee Gray
text: Great massage as always, right amount of pressure and comes to you which is so convenient. Highly recommend

name: Darran Polsen
text: Chris was very professional and exceeded my expectations with his knowledge as he found issues that I didn’t realise I had with my back. Highly Recommended!
